players.product: silicon-photonics foundry services (PH18 SiPho platform) + SiGe drivers/TIAs

connects_to.relationship: SiGe foundry capacity for Semtech signal-integrity ICs (TIAs, modulator and laser drivers, linear equalizers)

contracts.signal: Tower and Semtech announced an expanded multi-year agreement building on their 20-year partnership, under which Semtech will invest in securing dedicated silicon germanium (SiGe) capacity at Tower to support its design wins and demand for AI data center optical interconnect components; the secured capacity spans Tower's fabs in the United States, Israel and Japan. Semtech's TIAs, modulator and laser drivers and linear equalizers are built on Tower's SiGe process and serve FRO, LPO, LRO, NPO and XPO optics and active copper cables, from 800G and 1.6T today through 3.2T. Tower CEO Russell Ellwanger expects the partnership to ensure 'a continual expansion of our already leading market share in optical transceiver connectivity'.
contracts.units: dedicated SiGe capacity across Tower fabs in the United States, Israel and Japan
